observations.detail: The narrator delivers the opening lines with high energy, matching the dramatic lightning visuals.
The word-by-word captions are highly legible and well-positioned over the dark space background.
The red emphasis color for the danger-themed shot is applied correctly to the text.
The transition between shots is smooth, maintaining a consistent pace.
The narrator's tone remains engaging and clear throughout the middle section.
The final shots conclude with precise subtitle synchronization and strong vocal delivery.

summary: The documentary narration is highly engaging, featuring strong vocal delivery, excellent caption readability, and precise synchronization with the dramatic space-science visuals.
